source.description: A deterministic C5 accounting fixture for previous-day BUY, next-day SELL and settlement-day cash release. It is not market data.

semantics.prices: BUY 100 at 10.0000 plus 5.0000 fee on 2024-01-04; SELL 100 at 10.2500 plus 5.0000 fee on 2024-01-05; 1020.0000 receivable is released on 2024-01-08.
qualityCases: unsettled SELL receivable cannot fund a BUY

expectedAssertions.description: The prior-day BUY is filled from the frozen input.
The next-trading-day SELL is filled and delivered.
SELL proceeds remain unavailable before settlement.
Settlement releases exactly the frozen receivable.
Portfolio and independent FakeBroker balance after settlement.
